in_sanskrit.name: मूलचन्द
in_sanskrit.meaning: Root (Mool) [of the earth, person or thing] (Mool) [the one who has] (Chand) [moon, joy, happiness]
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the root of the earth or the one who has the joy and happiness of the moon

in_hindi.name: मूलचन्द
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has the root (of the earth, person or thing) and the joy and happiness (of the moon)

in_tamil.name: முழ்சந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has the root and the happiness and joy

in_telugu.name: మూళచంద
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has the root and the joy and happiness

in_marathi.name: Mulchand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mill
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mulchand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mul meaning mill or wheel, and Chand meaning lord or master. This name is derived from the Hindu god Mulnath, who is the deity of mills and agriculture.

in_bengali.name: Mulchand
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Mill
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mulchand একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mul meaning mill or wheel, and Chand meaning lord or master. This name is derived from the Hindu god Mulnath, who is the deity of mills and agriculture.
